title: Étale covers with a prescribed exterior sheet
main_claim: For X a smooth proper curve of genus at least 2 over \bar k (k/Q_p finite), with finitely many disjoint open disks V_i and exterior U, there is a connected finite étale cover g:Y→X with a component of g^{-1}(U) mapping isomorphically to U, and with p dividing the degree of every component of g^{-1}(V_i) over V_i.
coverage:
Read the whole paper (4 sections) and checked every step.
- Lemma 2.1: components, transitivity and degree |B|.
- Prop 2.2: model refinement placing two smooth points with tubes inside V_i; RNS positive-genus vertices, with all lifts positive-genus via Lüroth and Galois transitivity; retracting a path keeps it inside its own image, giving a simple edge path above V_i; the H^1 surjection from the normalization sequence; nonzero ℓ-torsion character on positive-genus components; lifting via SGA1 IX 1.10; geometric connectedness; stability via Riemann–Hurwitz; the Betti count b1 ≥ ℓ−1; the Galois closure keeping cycles (b1 ≥ c ≥ 1).
- Lemma 3.1: an irrational type-3 cut point has a singleton retraction fibre, so the cyclic degree-p graph cover splits over U_Z; connectedness over the component containing C_i; algebraization via de Jong Lemma 2.6, GAGA and SGA1 X 1.8.
- Section 4: H∩P=1 from splitting; B∩P≠1 for every disk component (normality of P plus transitivity); the image degree [B:B∩H], checked by coset counting |HB|/|H|; divisibility by |N|. All steps are valid.
Residual risk: I did not check the exact hypotheses of the cited Mochizuki–Tsujimura Theorem A, or its alternative RNS formulation, against the source. This includes the positive-genus conclusion for an arbitrary normal model and closed point.
sibling_notes: Family 019 sibling (p-adic section conjecture, rank 230) also relies on Mochizuki–Tsujimura Theorem A and was also found gap-free, with the same residual risk about the cited hypotheses. Posted to the board.
